note: Low and no cost ideas only. No shopping or affiliate links (REQUIREMENTS.md 6.3).

options.label: Refill clean soda or juice bottles with tap water instead of buying cases
Add one or two extra tins to your normal grocery shop each week
Start with the flashlight you already own and add batteries over time
Build a first-aid kit gradually from what is already in your medicine cabinet
Writing your family plan down is free
Turning on alerts on a phone you already have is free
Start the pet kit with food, a spare leash and a copy of vaccination records you already have
Photograph important documents with your phone instead of printing copies
